region_name_zh: 中美洲、加勒比海西語區與南美西語國家
ai_language_tip: Use neutral, polite Latin American Spanish (es) with formal 'usted'; in Puerto Rico (pr) or Panama/Costa Rica tourism, switch to English smoothly if staff leads.
english_ok: sometimes — Widely spoken in Puerto Rico, Panama City, and Costa Rica tourist hubs; limited elsewhere outside upscale hotels.
politeness: Courteous 'Buenos días/Buenas tardes', 'por favor', and 'usted' (essential in Colombia, Costa Rica, and Andes; universally polite in Caribbean/Chile).
name_tip: Given name and first surname (e.g. Andrés Gómez, Camila Rojas); hotels and clinics ask two surnames; avoid national ID requests.
phone_tip: Formats vary (CO 300 123 4567, CL 9 1234 5678, PE 912 345 678, CR 8123-4567, PR 787-555-0123); read in pairs/triplets; WhatsApp rules everywhere.
time_tip: 12-hour AM/PM spoken everywhere (7 de la noche, 12:30 del mediodía); 'faltan quince para las ocho' = 7:45; confirm AM/PM explicitly.
number_tip: Caribbean/Chilean Spanish drops syllable-final 's' ('do' for dos, 'tre' for tres); confirm party count and digits carefully.
avoid_calling: Avoid lunch peak 12:30–14:30 (small-town clinics/shops may close 12:30–14:00) and calls after 20:30–21:00.
closed_days: Many clinics/workshops close Sundays and Saturday afternoons; Holy Week (Semana Santa), Christmas–New Year, and Carnaval cause multi-day closures.
booking_channels: WhatsApp Business is the primary channel across all 16 countries; Mesa 24/7 (PE/CL) and OpenTable for upscale dining; Doctoralia in CO/CL/PE.
voice_menu: EPS/Isapre health networks, banks, Claro/Movistar/Tigo, airlines (Avianca/LATAM/Copa), and utilities use heavy keypad IVR.
callback_habits: WhatsApp confirmation message or location pin request is standard; clinics and salons message 24h ahead to reconfirm.

restaurant.before_dialing_zh: 秘魯與智利高檔餐廳多用 Mesa 24/7 綁卡，一般餐廳接電話與 WhatsApp；多數國家會問國家證件號但訂位其實非必須。
usually_asked: Date and lunch vs dinner hour (almuerzo ~13:00 vs cena ~20:00)
Number of guests and children/highchair (silla de bebé)

may_come_up.what: Upscale Lima/Santiago/Bogotá restaurant sends Mesa 24/7 or CoverManager card-hold link
15-minute grace period (tolerancia) on table

sensitive_asked.what: Asks Cédula/DNI/RUT for reservation record
Demands immediate Yape/Plin/Nequi/SINPE Móvil/ATH Móvil transfer

clinic.before_dialing_zh: 公保醫療網（如哥國 EPS、智利醫療中心）總機常需按鍵輸入證件號；私人牙醫與診所較適合電話約。
usually_asked: Private self-pay (particular) vs insurer (EPS/Prepagada in CO, Isapre/Fonasa in CL, Seguro/Plan médico in PR)
Specialty or dental service and first-visit status

may_come_up.what: Large clinic IVR demands keying in RUT/Cédula/DNI digits
Quotes private consultation fee vs insurance copay (bono/copago)

sensitive_asked.what: Asks RUT (CL), Cédula (CO/CR/EC/VE/DO), DNI (PE), or health insurance card number

beauty.before_dialing_zh: 獨立美甲、美睫與沙龍常要求透過當地手機錢包（Yape、Nequi、SINPE、ATH Móvil）預付訂金。

may_come_up.what: Salon asks owner to confirm via WhatsApp message

sensitive_asked.what: Demands mobile-wallet deposit (abono via Nequi/Yape/SINPE/ATH Móvil) now

repair.before_dialing_zh: 獨立修車廠（Taller）與家電手機行電話直接；哥倫比亞波哥大與秘魯利馬等大城送修汽車需注意車牌限行（Pico y placa）。

may_come_up.what: Pico y placa / restricción vehicular affects which day car can drive in
Diagnostic fee (revisión técnica) quoted upfront

sensitive_asked.what: Asks phone unlock PIN or national ID
Demands transfer upfront to order spare part

takeout.before_dialing_zh: 烤雞店（Pollería，如秘魯 Pollo a la brasa）、披薩與中餐（Chifa）極常接電話訂自取或現金外送。
usually_asked: Order items, combos, sauces, and drinks

may_come_up.what: Asks whether customer needs tax receipt (boleta vs factura) or cash change
Directs card/online payment orders to PedidosYa or Rappi

sensitive_asked.what: Requires Yape/Plin/Nequi/SINPE transfer before dispatching rider
Asks RUC/RUT/Cédula for invoice

shop_order.before_dialing_zh: 獨立五金行（ferretería）、藥局、花店與書店可電話查現貨（stock）並短暫留貨；大賣場走客服語音。
usually_asked: Product name, brand, model, or size

may_come_up.what: Cuba/Venezuela shops may quote currency/payment method acceptance rules
Holds item at counter for a few hours only

sensitive_asked.what: Requires instant mobile payment deposit to reserve item

change.before_dialing_zh: 電話改期或取消很常見，醫療診所偶爾會要求核對證件號以定位病歷。

may_come_up.what: Late change forfeits prior abono/deposit

sensitive_asked.what: Clinic asks Cédula/DNI/RUT to pull up appointment

usually_asked: Question (hours, secure parking/parqueadero, pet policy, stock, power/water status)

may_come_up.what: Offers sending catalog/menu PDF via WhatsApp

hotel.before_dialing_zh: 中小型旅館與生態旅宿常接電話並引導加 WhatsApp 發付款連結；大型飯店有語音總機且需刷卡擔保。
usually_asked: Guest full name, phone, and nationality (foreign tourists exempt from VAT in PE/CL/CO with passport at check-in)

may_come_up.what: Foreign non-resident tax exemption rule explained (bring passport at check-in)
Sends payment link by email/WhatsApp to confirm

sensitive_asked.what: Requests passport/ID number or credit card digits over phone
Demands immediate bank/wallet transfer

activity.before_dialing_zh: 五人制足球場（Cancha sintética）、板網球、保齡球與體驗課常接電話問場次，鎖場多需預付訂金。

may_come_up.what: Holds court provisionally for 30–60 mins pending owner's deposit

sensitive_asked.what: Requires 50% transfer (Yape/Nequi/SINPE/Zelle) to confirm

home_service.before_dialing_zh: 地址格式各國差異極大（如哥倫比亞 Carrera/Calle 座標、哥斯大黎加地標方位），強烈建議主人寫明地標並準備傳 WhatsApp 定位。
usually_asked: Service type (plomería/gasfitería, aire acondicionado, electricidad, cerrajería)
Full local address with neighborhood/barrio/urbanización and reference landmark

may_come_up.what: Technician asks owner to send Waze/Google Maps pin via WhatsApp (essential in CR/NI/PA)
Quotes inspection visit fee (visita técnica)

sensitive_asked.what: Asks building access code or national ID
Demands upfront mobile transfer before arriving

pet.before_dialing_zh: 獸醫、寵物洗澡美容（peluquería/baño）與寄宿（guardería/hotel canino）電話預約普遍。
usually_asked: Vet consult, grooming bath/cut, or boarding
Preferred slot or pet shuttle pickup (ruta/transporte)

may_come_up.what: Offers paid door-to-door pet transport (ruta canina)

sensitive_asked.what: Boarding requires advance transfer deposit

tracking.before_dialing_zh: 全國物流（Servientrega、Chilexpress、Olva、Correos）客服多有語音按鍵，地方營業所或獨立維修店才適合直撥。
usually_asked: Waybill/tracking number (número de guía / orden de transporte)

may_come_up.what: Main courier hotline uses keypad IVR requiring ID entry

sensitive_asked.what: Asks Cédula/DNI/RUT or delivery secret code

customer_service.before_dialing_zh: 電信（Claro/Movistar/Tigo）、銀行、水電與航空公司皆有按鍵選單並強制核對本人證件號（Cédula/DNI/RUT），AI 無法代辦。
usually_asked: Keypad IVR menu and ID number entry on keypad
Cédula/DNI/RUT, birth date, and security questions

may_come_up.what: IVR blocks before human agent without keypad ID input

sensitive_asked.what: Asks Cédula/DNI/RUT, birth date, card number, or OTP

transport.before_dialing_zh: 安全無線計程車隊（Taxi Seguro / Radio Taxi）、機場接送與租車行常接電話派車，並回報車牌確保安全。
usually_asked: Exact pickup address, building/conjunto name, and time

may_come_up.what: Dispatcher gives driver plate number and security code (clave) for safe boarding
Fixed airport rate quoted in local currency or USD (EC/PA/SV/CR/VE)

sensitive_asked.what: Requests passport/ID or card number over phone

property.before_dialing_zh: 房仲（Corredora/Inmobiliaria）電話約看房時，常先問保證人（Fiador/Codeudor）或收入證明條件。
usually_asked: Employment/solvency profile (aval/codeudor in CO/CL, depósito in PA/CR/PE)

may_come_up.what: Building guardhouse requires visitor full name in advance; ID shown physically on arrival

sensitive_asked.what: Asks Cédula/RUT/DNI number over phone or deposit before viewing

government_school.before_dialing_zh: 政府機關多需線上預約且總機有按鍵選單；私立學校、雙語學校與幼兒園（Nido/Jardín/Preescolar）歡迎來電約參觀。
usually_asked: Procedure requirements or school admissions tour
Academic calendar (Calendario A vs B in CO; March start in CL/PE)

may_come_up.what: Public agency requires in-person or portal appointment with national ID

sensitive_asked.what: Asks citizen ID (Cédula/DNI/RUT) or student birth date
